description: On 2026-09-17, cargo test --test fz2_cli on fz-4nh.3/direct-distill rebased onto origin/main started the two native analyzer tests (captured trace and synthetic --top 6 input). Both fz2 run tools/distill-telemetry.fz processes remained CPU-bound for more than five minutes and did not complete; the test processes were stopped. Reproduce with cargo test --test fz2_cli native_telemetry_distiller. Find the non-converging compilation/runtime work, add a bounded regression signal, and restore the two tests to completion.
title: Investigate native telemetry distiller end-to-end compilation hang
